mood.label: CAUTIOUSLY-RISK-ON
mood.summary: Markets are near all-time highs on cooling inflation data reducing Fed hike fears, but a surprise drop in retail sales and rising oil prices from Middle East tensions introduce a note of caution.

indicesNarrative: US futures are mixed after the S&P 500 closed at a record high yesterday, buoyed by softer inflation data that has tempered expectations for a September rate hike. Tech is showing relative strength in the pre-market, while rising oil prices due to geopolitical tensions and a weak retail sales report are keeping broader sentiment in check.

sectorsNarrative: Overnight action in Asia showed a clear preference for technology and semiconductor stocks, with South Korea's KOSPI outperforming. Yesterday's session in the US was also led by Tech and Communication Services.
